# Backyard Pool Tips

> Independent pool equipment reviews and maintenance advice for backyard pool owners, written by Tom and Shirley Springsteen from 30 years running a pool shop. Buying guides start with the pool, not the product; recommendations are based on running cost and practical suitability, not commission.

## Buying guides

- [Best Pool Pump for Above-Ground Pools](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-pump-above-ground): Flow rate versus pool size, sizing, running costs, noise, and five pumps worth considering.
- [Best Pool Pump for Inground Pools](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-pump-inground): Single-speed vs variable-speed payback math, plumbing sizing, rebates, and five pumps worth considering.
- [Salt vs Chlorine: True Maintenance Cost](https://backyardpooltips.com/salt-vs-chlorine-cost): The real 3-year cost comparison between a salt chlorination system and manual chlorine dosing, plus five salt systems worth considering.
- [Best Pool Covers by Type & Size](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-covers): Solar, thermal, safety and winter covers explained and matched to climate and pool shape, plus five covers worth considering.
- [Best Pool Cleaning Robots & Equipment](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-cleaning-robots): What separates a robot that climbs walls from one that gets stuck, runtime and filter maintenance, plus five cleaners worth considering.
- [Best Pool Heaters & Heat Pumps](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-heaters): Heat pump vs gas heater explained honestly, real running-cost math, sizing by climate, plus five heaters worth considering.
- [Best Pool Filters: Sand vs Cartridge vs DE](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-filters): The three filter types compared on filtration quality, maintenance effort and running cost, plus five filters worth considering.
- [Best Pool Accessories Worth Actually Owning](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-accessories): What genuinely earns a place in the pool shed vs what's marketed hard but rarely worth it, plus five accessories worth considering.

## Maintenance guides

- [Cloudy Water? Start Here.](https://backyardpooltips.com/cloudy-water): A complete, step-by-step guide to fixing cloudy pool water — testing, balancing, and filtering in the right order, every likely cause explained, and the mistake that makes it worse.
- [Green Pool? How to Fix It](https://backyardpooltips.com/green-pool): Why pools turn green, the correct step-by-step order to clear an algae bloom, and how to stop it coming back.
- [How to Detect and Fix a Pool Leak](https://backyardpooltips.com/pool-leak): The bucket test to confirm a real leak vs normal evaporation, common leak locations, and when to call a professional.
- [How to Shock a Pool (Properly)](https://backyardpooltips.com/how-to-shock-a-pool): The 4 types of shock and when to use each, real dosing guidance, a step-by-step process, and why shock sometimes doesn't seem to work.
- [Why Does My Pool Smell Like Chlorine?](https://backyardpooltips.com/why-pool-smells-like-chlorine): A strong chlorine smell actually means too little effective chlorine (chloramines), not too much - what's really happening and the fix.
- [Opening a Pool the Right Way](https://backyardpooltips.com/opening-a-pool): The correct order of operations for opening a pool for the season — cover off, prime the pump, balance before you shock.
- [Closing a Pool for Winter](https://backyardpooltips.com/closing-a-pool): What to drain, what to leave alone, and the step most guides skip when winterizing.
- [Common Pump & Filter Problems](https://backyardpooltips.com/pump-filter-problems): Symptom-to-fix troubleshooting for losing prime, short cycling, rising pressure, weak flow, and cloudy water.
- [Pool Water Chemistry Cheat Sheet](https://backyardpooltips.com/pool-chemistry-cheat-sheet): Every ideal range in one place - free chlorine, pH, alkalinity, calcium hardness, CYA and salt - plus the correct order to balance them.
- [Sand Filter Pressure Gauge Not Moving](https://backyardpooltips.com/sand-filter-pressure-gauge-not-moving): The specific causes behind a gauge stuck at zero, stuck at one reading, or not climbing as expected, and how to replace one.
- [Why Does My Pool Foam?](https://backyardpooltips.com/why-does-my-pool-foam): What actually causes pool foam - algaecide, low calcium hardness, bather load - and how to clear and prevent it.
- [Black Algae vs Green Algae](https://backyardpooltips.com/black-algae-vs-green-algae): Why black algae resists normal chlorine levels and needs a different brush-and-shock treatment than green algae.
- [Salt Cell Not Producing Chlorine](https://backyardpooltips.com/salt-cell-not-producing-chlorine): Six specific causes to check in order - low salt, scale, cold water, low flow, cell age, and wiring faults.
- [Using Bleach Instead of Pool Chlorine](https://backyardpooltips.com/using-bleach-instead-of-pool-chlorine): The real dosing math and cost comparison for using plain household bleach as pool chlorine, and what to avoid.
- [Pool Losing Water at the Skimmer Line](https://backyardpooltips.com/pool-losing-water-at-skimmer-line): The specific leak points around a skimmer - housing cracks, gasket wear, liner tears - and how to narrow down which one.
- [Cloudy Pool After Adding Shock](https://backyardpooltips.com/cloudy-pool-after-shock): Why a brief haze after shocking is normal, and the specific causes when it lingers past 2-3 days.
- [When to Close Your Pool: A Climate Zone Guide](https://backyardpooltips.com/when-to-close-your-pool): Closing timing isn't one-size-fits-all - how to pick the right week based on water temperature and first frost date by US climate zone.
